mutations.name: the digest never reads the publish record
kills: seat digest of a review that could not be synced names a dismissal that failed after its retries at the PR's head, with the recorded reason

mutations.name: a failure at a moved-past head is still told
kills: seat digest of a review that could not be synced tells nothing for a failure at a head the PR has moved past

mutations.name: a missing App is told as a review failure
kills: seat digest of a review that could not be synced tells nothing when the only error is that no review App is configured

mutations.name: the oldest publish decides, not the newest
kills: seat digest of a review that could not be synced tells nothing once a later publish at the head synced the review
